activity_summary: The loaf was a penny and still a thumb short, and she would not measure it again. You put the clove in and ate the soft of the loaf. Alse left Gib on the lent book. You did not call the jaw a cure, and you did not give the parish a story.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Put the clove in, ate, and left the book under the cat.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Refused a second measuring, and limited what he might tell the parish.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Set the clove, and left Gib where he was.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: On the Holinshed. Nobody moved him.

quotes.text: The loaf is a penny. It is still a thumb short of the notch.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The clove is going in. The jaw is the jaw.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: If the parish asks after your face, you may tell them it is a tooth.
